facts.text: University of the Pacific is California's oldest university, founded July 10, 1851, and remains the only Methodist-related university in California.

sources.title: History and Mission | University of the Pacific
sources.quote: University of the Pacific is California's oldest university, founded July 10, 1851—less than a year after California received statehood. Established by pioneering Methodist ministers, it remains the only Methodist-related university in California.
